examples.en: I already have the wedding rings.

examples.text: Pourquoi ne portes-tu pas ton alliance ?
examples.en: Why aren't you wearing your wedding ring?

examples.text: Elle lui est apparentée par alliance.
examples.en: She is related to him by marriage.

examples.text: Il est mon parent par alliance.
examples.en: He is related to me by marriage.

examples.text: Tom retira son alliance et la jeta dans l'étang.
examples.en: Tom took off his wedding ring and threw it into the pond.
